# Third-party code shipped inside Aethron

`studio.py`'s `METAL_JS` constant (served at `/metal.js`) is generated by
`vendor/build_metal.py` from two upstream projects. Aethron reimplements
nothing about the effect; the engine code is theirs, unchanged apart
from module syntax.

## @paper-design/shaders — Apache-2.0

One symbol, `liquidMetalFragmentShader` — the fragment shader metal-fx
imports and its own build inlines, so the material stays byte-identical
to Paper's.

## Regenerating

    python3 vendor/build_metal.py --install

Fetches both upstreams into `vendor/.cache` (git clone + npm pack),
flattens, gates the result as a classic script, and splices it into
`studio.py`. Nothing in `vendor/.cache` is committed.
